description: This file defines the 'RandomData' interface in the Apache Commons Math library, providing utility method signatures for generating various types of random data, including integers, long integers, floating point numbers, distributions, and secure random data. It is marked as deprecated and is intended to be replaced by 'RandomDataGenerator'.

methods.name: nextHexString
methods.description: Generates a random string of hexadecimal characters of specified length; not cryptographically secure.

methods.name: nextInt
methods.description: Generates a uniformly distributed random integer within a specified range.

methods.name: nextLong
methods.description: Generates a uniformly distributed random long integer within a specified range.

methods.name: nextSecureHexString
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure random string of hexadecimal characters.

methods.name: nextSecureInt
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure random integer within a specified range.

methods.name: nextSecureLong
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure random long integer within a specified range.

methods.name: nextPoisson
methods.description: Generates a random value from the Poisson distribution with a given mean.

methods.name: nextGaussian
methods.description: Generates a random value from the Normal distribution with specified mean and standard deviation.

methods.name: nextExponential
methods.description: Generates a random value from the exponential distribution with given mean.

methods.name: nextUniform
methods.description: Generates a uniform random value in an open interval (lower, upper).

methods.name: nextUniform with lowerInclusive
methods.description: Generates a uniform random value, including or excluding bounds based on parameters.

methods.name: nextPermutation
methods.description: Returns a random permutation of k elements from a set of size n.

methods.name: nextSample
methods.description: Samples k objects randomly from a collection without replacement.
